1 Hear, my people, and pay attention to the words of my lips?. If any one brings gifts to an earthly prince, but having unfaithfulness in his heart: if the prince knows it, will he not be angry with him on account of that, and he will not take his gifts, and will hand him over to condemnation ?

2 Or if a man flatters another in his language, but (plans) evil against him in his heart, will not the other understand the craft of his heart, and he himself will be condemned, so that his unrighteousness will be evident to all??
4 But when God shall send a great light, by means O that there will be judgement to the just and unjust, dnd nothing will be concealed.
